baseline_models.focus_anchor: The singular perfect verb gathers whatever is in the heavens and earth into an act directed to God.
baseline_models.mechanism: The upper and lower poles form a spatial totality whose members are presented as one completed act of worship and praise.

activation_trace.role: Worship through praise, prayer, and remembrance supplies the ayah's explicit cultic action.
The worshipped one supplies the devotional destination of the action.
What is above and overshadows supplies the upper pole of the totality.
The lower realm opposite the sky closes the spatial merism.

changed_reading.before: Separate beings happen to utter praise.
changed_reading.after: All upper and lower reality is grammatically gathered as one accomplished act of worship directed to God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exonerating branch of sabbaha is sharpened by al-Aziz and al-Hakim.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation's act functions as a universal clearing of God from deficiency: irresistible efficacy and corrective restraint rule out weakness, disorder, and injustice.

activation_trace.role: Exoneration and distancing from defect turn praise into a cosmic verdict.
Overcoming force excludes any reading of divine incapacity.
Restraint that blocks corruption gives the verdict a corrective, ordering force.

changed_reading.after: The whole cosmos bears an exonerating judgment that power and governance are free of defect.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Sabbaha can evoke swimming or running, while heavens and earth span the field of movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verbal root permits cosmic motion itself to be heard as praise; the sky supplies the medium, the ground supplies the lower limit, and wisdom supplies coherence rather than random drift.

activation_trace.role: Swimming, running, and stellar coursing supply the kinetic image at the verbal anchor.
The overhanging sky supplies the upper medium of the imagined course.
The ground opposite the sky supplies the course's lower bound.
Firm coherence turns movement into an ordered mechanism rather than undirected motion.

changed_reading.before: Praise is primarily imagined as speech.
changed_reading.after: The ordered coursing of creation can itself be carried as its praise.

context_deltas.mechanism: First/last and manifest/hidden add temporal and perceptual merisms to the focus ayah's spatial merism, making 'whatever' exhaustive across phases and layers as well as places.

activation_trace.role: The overhanging sky supplies one spatial endpoint of the baseline totality.
The lower realm supplies the opposing spatial endpoint.
Beginning and precedence open a temporal axis for the totality.
Laterness after the first closes that temporal axis.
Emergence and disclosure supply the visible pole.
Hidden inwardness supplies the concealed pole.

structural_cues: 57:3 stacks two coordinated oppositional pairs immediately after 57:1's heavens/earth pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: three paired axes are supplied. Inference: their parallelism expands the scope of 'whatever.' Alternative: 57:3 may simply list divine attributes without recoding 57:1's merism.

changed_reading.before: Everything in the two spatial realms praises.
changed_reading.after: Every beginning and end, exposed surface and hidden interior within those realms participates in the praise.

context_deltas.mechanism: Entry, exit, descent, and ascent instantiate the focus root's swimming/running image as continuous exchange through the upper and lower world; the repeated insertion of night and day makes the completed tasbih dynamic rather than static.

activation_trace.role: Swimming and coursing provide the focus-anchored kinetic template.
Entry into another interior supplies the first directional transfer.
Passage outward supplies the inverse transfer from earth.
Descent supplies the downward leg from heaven.
Ascent supplies the answering upward leg.
Repeated mutual entry makes circulation reciprocal through night and day.

structural_cues: 57:4 orders in/out and down/up, while 57:6 repeats the same entry verb in reversed night/day clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: directional verbs and their reversals are supplied. Inference: their ordered circulation is an enacted instance of sabbaha. Alternative: the sequence may only inventory divine knowledge and control.

changed_reading.before: Heavens and earth are stationary containers whose occupants praise.
changed_reading.after: Their permeable, reciprocal circulation is itself a continuous form of cosmic praise.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine possession, human succession, spending, inheritance, and lending convert universal worship into an economy of relinquishment: humans join what already belongs to God by releasing entrusted goods rather than treating them as autonomous property.

activation_trace.role: Cultic service anchors economic release as a mode of worship rather than an independent theme.
Possession and disposal establish the prior ownership under which goods circulate.
Standing after another in their place recasts humans as temporary successors.
The going-out of wealth supplies the human act that answers cosmic devotion.
Transfer from a predecessor to an heir denies permanent human possession.
A cut portion given for returned recompense makes relinquishment materially concrete.

structural_cues: 57:7-11 repeat giving language between declarations that the heavens and earth are God's kingdom and inheritance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: ownership, succession, expenditure, inheritance, and loan are supplied. Inference: release is the human enactment of 57:1's universal worship. Alternative: the economic commands may follow sovereignty without defining tasbih's human form.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports a nonhuman cosmic hymn.
changed_reading.after: It also establishes a material ethic: entrusted wealth praises by being released into God's claimed order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Low dormant earth, hard hearts, dead land, and rain-born life form a material analogy: the earth in 57:1 is not only a praising object but a diagnostic model for a heart becoming soft, alive, and able to join that praise.

activation_trace.role: Soft fertile earth supplies the focus anchor for receptivity and growth.
Worship supplies the capacity into which the revived heart is being read.
Low dormant ground gives humility a material earth-image.
Loss of heart-softness supplies the blocked condition.
Earth's life through rain and growth supplies the reversal of that blockage.
Lifeless land supplies the initial state from which revival proceeds.

structural_cues: The hard-heart warning in 57:16 is immediately followed by the explicit revival of dead earth in 57:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: heart hardness and earth revival are adjacent. Inference: the earth sequence models recovery of the heart's capacity for tasbih. Alternative: revival may only prove resurrection, with no inward analogy.

changed_reading.before: Earth is one member of the praising cosmos.
changed_reading.after: Earth also stages how a deadened human interior can be softened, revived, and re-enter cosmic worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The self-sufficient and already praiseworthy names prevent universal tasbih from being read as supplying a divine lack; creation recognizes value it does not create.

activation_trace.role: Praise and worship provide the act whose dependence is being clarified.
Self-sufficiency blocks the inference that praise fills a need.
Praise as the opposite of blame marks intrinsic praiseworthiness as the response's ground.

structural_cues: 57:24 joins al-Ghani and al-Hamid after condemning withholding and turning away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: self-sufficiency and praiseworthiness are paired. Inference: they specify the non-reciprocal logic of 57:1's praise. Alternative: the pair may address human miserliness without commenting on cosmic tasbih.

changed_reading.before: Universal praise might sound like a contribution God receives.
changed_reading.after: Universal praise is dependent recognition of one already praiseworthy and independent of it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Balance, uprightness, justice, iron, and concentrated strength concretize al-Aziz al-Hakim as a coupled mechanism: effective force is bounded and directed by measure, while measure is made operative by force.

activation_trace.role: Strength and inviolability supply the effective-power side of the attribute pair.
Restraint that prevents corruption supplies the governing side of the pair.
A balance of justice gives restraint a measurable public form.
Upright equilibrium supplies the human posture the mechanism is meant to produce.
Justice and equity name the social direction of measured power.
Iron's resistant hardness materializes coercive capacity.
Strength gathered like rope strands confirms that effective force is composed and concentrated.

structural_cues: 57:25 places book and balance beside iron, then closes with al-Qawi al-Aziz.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: measure and force are coordinated in one verse. Inference: this coordination unfolds the focus pair al-Aziz al-Hakim and makes ordered justice a human analogue of cosmic tasbih. Alternative: balance and iron may be parallel gifts rather than mutually governing capacities.

changed_reading.before: Al-Aziz and al-Hakim are two appended honorifics.
changed_reading.after: They name a single constitutional pattern: force made just by measure and measure made effective by force.

context_deltas.mechanism: Light is brought out from darkness, moves ahead, can be sought from another, and enables walking; this sequence moralizes the focus root's coursing image as a differentiated path rather than undirected cosmic motion.

activation_trace.role: Coursing through a medium supplies the kinetic focus anchor.
Passage outward supplies light's emergence from darkness.
Illumination supplies the medium and result of the emergence.
Purposeful movement makes the believers' light an advancing course.
Light requested from another reveals that access to the course can be socially differentiated.
Walking converts illumination into sustained guided movement.

structural_cues: 57:9, 57:12-13, and 57:28 repeatedly bind light to exit, forward motion, failed borrowing, and walking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a repeated light-and-motion sequence is supplied. Inference: it activates sabbaha's coursing branch as a moral trajectory. Alternative: these are eschatological and guidance images unrelated to the focus verb's motion branch.

changed_reading.before: Cosmic motion praises simply by being ordered.
changed_reading.after: The course becomes ethically differentiated: received light advances and enables walking, while uncarried light cannot be borrowed at the boundary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant W-S-M mapping for the focus root S-M-W and treats a material analogy as activation, not lexical substitution. It remains anchored in focus heavens, earth, and sabbaha and is reinforced by packet rain/plant branches; downstream prose should label it an exploratory image rather than translate 'heavens' as 'marking.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The heavens' split inventory includes first rain marking earth with vegetation, beside fertile earth and kinetic sabbaha.

activation_trace.role: First rain that marks earth with plants supplies the non-dominant inscription image at the heaven anchor.
Soft fertile ground supplies the receptive surface of the mark.
Life-giving rain descending from heaven supplies the marking medium.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the visible trace left by that medium.

changed_reading.before: Heaven and earth are two locations that praise.
changed_reading.after: Heaven writes upon earth through rain and growth, so their reciprocal inscription can be imagined as visible tasbih.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the packet's L-J-J target under context W-L-J. It remains useful because exact mutual-entry occurrences meet the focus root's swimming image; downstream prose should present two interpenetrating deep currents as poetic containment, not as the direct sense of yuliju.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The swimming branch of sabbaha can receive the context's repeated mutual entry of night and day.

activation_trace.role: Swimming and coursing supply the focus anchor for the fluid image.
The alternate image of a sea's depth turns repeated mutual entry into interpenetrating currents.

changed_reading.before: Night and day alternate by entering one another.
changed_reading.after: They can be carried as two deep currents swimming into one another within the cosmos's praise.

strongest_changes: The static heaven/earth chorus became a multidirectional circulation of entry, exit, descent, ascent, night, and day.
Cosmic worship acquired human material forms in entrusted spending and in the revival of a hardened heart through the earth analogy.
Al-Aziz al-Hakim became a coupled mechanism of effective force governed by balance and justice.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made motion, material exchange, ecological revival, and public justice coexist without collapsing them; split mappings also preserved the exploratory images of rain inscribing earth and night/day as deep currents.
remaining_uncertainties: The kinetic reading may be a productive activation of sabbaha rather than its governing sense.
The economic and luminous sequences may unfold consequences of cosmic praise without defining its mechanism.
The two split-root outliers require explicit qualification because their force is analogical and branch-distant.
